sentence: This project studies how messages against e-cigarette use spread on Twitter and TikTok, and how people respond to them, using machine learning.
This project supports research in molecular pharmacology aimed at turning basic discoveries into therapies for human diseases.
This project builds an imaging method that uses fluorescence to map differences within tumors in live animals and how therapeutic antibodies reach them.
This project builds and tests a smartphone program that sends messages to young adults at risky moments for nicotine vaping.
This project studies how cannabis use affects alcohol treatment in adolescents who use cannabis, and how it relates to later treatment outcomes.
This project tests whether a tool using artificial intelligence can help dentists and patients communicate better in oral surgery and dental implant care.
This project builds a framework that explains how groups of neurons in the brain represent information, using machine learning.
This project uses CT scans to measure damage to tiny blood vessels in the lungs of smokers and how it relates to emphysema.
This project uses imaging of tissue around the eye to find measurable signs of how active thyroid eye disease is.
This project builds machine learning methods that combine several kinds of biological and patient data to predict outcomes in melioidosis, a bacterial disease.
This project builds fluorescent reporters that measure how active the protein degradation system is, in mouse and patient samples.
This project develops small molecules that block a protein interaction involving menin, and tests them in leukemia models.
This project studies how alcohol exposure before birth causes heart defects, using zebrafish embryos and single cell sequencing.
This project uses ultrasound imaging to guide proton therapy so that radiation harms less normal tissue in cancer patients.
This project builds software and a website that help researchers combine, view and share molecular network data.
This project tests which common DNA variants raise the risk of oral facial cleft, using cell lines, stem cells and mice.
This project studies why bladder cancer resists Bacillus Calmette-Guérin treatment, using RNA sequencing of patient tumor samples.
This project studies how places people visit in daily life affect their craving for cigarettes and smoking, using mobile phone location tracking.
This project measures biomarkers in fluid samples such as blood plasma from people with inherited Alzheimer disease.
This project studies how psilocybin affects behavior, receptors and brain activity to restore flexible thinking after chronic stress.
